 Petrol price fixed at Rs 346 per litre, diesel at Rs 378 in Pakistan 
 Web Desk 12:27 AM | November 07, 2026 Business Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on Facebook Share on Twitter The government has revised petroleum prices in Pakistan, setting the new rate of petrol at Rs346 per litre and high-speed diesel (HSD) at Rs378 per litre.
 The revised rates will affect millions of consumers, including motorists, commuters, and businesses relying on fuel for transportation and daily operations.
 Under the new pricing arrangement, petrol will be sold at Rs346 per litre, while high-speed diesel will be available at Rs378 per litre.

 The adjustment comes as changes in fuel prices remain a key concern for households and commercial sectors due to their direct impact on transportation costs and the prices of goods and services.
 However, details regarding the extent of the price adjustments and the date from which the new rates will take effect were not provided.
